mistake_one.title: You mistake speed for certainty
mistake_one.body: The thing you are strongest at — moving before the room has finished thinking — is also the thing that costs you most. A fire-and-sun profile reads its own momentum as evidence: because the decision came quickly, it feels like it came from somewhere deep. Often it did. Sometimes it came from nothing more than the discomfort of sitting still, and the two feel identical from the inside.
mistake_one.fix: Give any decision you can explain in under ten seconds one night before you act on it. Not a week — a night. If it is still obvious in the morning it was conviction; if it has gone quiet it was restlessness wearing conviction's coat.

styles.blurb: Everything registers and almost nothing shows — you read a room in seconds and give it back slowly, on your own terms.

palette.line: Midnight indigo is where you are most yourself, moon silver is what lets other people find you in it, and deep violet is the accent to use once in a room and never twice.
talismans: Moonstone — worn where you can reach it without looking
Labradorite — kept on the desk rather than on the body
A small dish of sea salt by the door you use

mistake_one.title: You wait for the perfect moment to say it
mistake_one.body: You take in more than anyone around you and hold it longer, which is why your read on a situation is almost always right. It is also why it arrives late. A water-and-moon profile trusts timing the way other people trust logic, and it will hold a true and useful thing for weeks waiting for a moment clean enough to deserve it. The moment rarely comes, the thing goes unsaid, and the situation resolves without you in it.
mistake_one.fix: Set a ceiling instead of a moment. Three days from noticing something to naming it, clumsy wording included. The awkward version said on Tuesday does more work than the perfect version you never quite reach.

mistake_one.title: You absorb the cost instead of naming it
mistake_one.body: Steadiness is the thing everyone around you relies on, and you deliver it so reliably that the delivery stops being visible. An earth-and-calm profile takes the extra hour, the awkward conversation, the thing nobody else picked up — and takes it quietly enough that no one ever learns it was extra. Over a few years the baseline moves. What you once took on as a favour is now simply what you do.
mistake_one.fix: Say the cost out loud once, at the moment it happens, without asking for anything in return. Not a complaint and not a negotiation — one sentence naming what it took. People adjust to information far more readily than they adjust to resentment.

mistake_one.title: You leave at the exact moment it gets valuable
mistake_one.body: You see the shape of a thing before anyone else does, and the seeing is genuinely the hard part — an air-and-sun profile turns out more usable ideas in a month than most people have in a year. But the interest is front-loaded. Once the shape is clear the rest reads as admin, so you move on, the idea belongs to whoever stayed, and you are left with the accurate and useless memory of having thought of it first.
mistake_one.fix: Pick one thing a quarter and stay past the point where it stops being interesting. Not everything — one. The boredom is not a signal that the work is finished; it is the toll on the stretch where the value actually gets collected.

purpose_path.offer_sub: Your year, mapped window by window — inside.

Aries.fire: An Aries that leads with Fire runs true — the start is the whole of it, and you are already moving while the room is still deciding.
Aries.earth: An Aries that leads with Earth is a genuine cross — the impulse arrives on time, but you build the thing before you announce it.
Aries.air: An Aries that leads with Air is uncommon — your speed goes into the argument rather than the action, and you win rooms you never meant to enter.
Aries.water: An Aries that leads with Water is rare — the charge is all still there, and it moves through what you feel rather than what you start.

Taurus.fire: A Taurus that leads with Fire is uncommon — the patience is real and it sits on top of a heat that only shows when something is being taken from you.
Taurus.earth: A Taurus that leads with Earth runs true — you hold ground by standing on it, and what you keep is the measure of you.
Taurus.air: A Taurus that leads with Air is a genuine cross — you settle slowly and think fast, so the decision is made long before you admit to it.
Taurus.water: A Taurus that leads with Water is uncommon — the steadiness is emotional rather than material, and comfort for you means being felt, not being furnished.

Gemini.fire: A Gemini that leads with Fire is uncommon — the two minds stop arguing the moment something is worth doing, and then you are all one direction.
Gemini.earth: A Gemini that leads with Earth is a genuine cross — you talk in possibilities and commit in specifics, and the specifics are what people remember.
Gemini.air: A Gemini that leads with Air runs true — you think out loud, in company, and the thought is finished only once somebody has answered it.
Gemini.water: A Gemini that leads with Water is rare — the quickness reads a room's mood before its words, and that is the half of you people call uncanny.

Cancer.fire: A Cancer that leads with Fire is uncommon — the shell is still there and there is something behind it that comes out first rather than last.
Cancer.earth: A Cancer that leads with Earth is a genuine cross — you look after people with logistics rather than sentiment, and it lands harder.
Cancer.air: A Cancer that leads with Air is rare — you feel it all and file it, and the distance you keep is a working distance rather than a cold one.
Cancer.water: A Cancer that leads with Water runs true — you take the temperature of a room before you take your coat off, and you are almost never wrong about it.

Leo.fire: A Leo that leads with Fire runs true — you warm a room by being in it, and the performance and the person are the same thing.
Leo.earth: A Leo that leads with Earth is a genuine cross — the shine is real and it is built, and you would rather be relied on than looked at.
Leo.air: A Leo that leads with Air is uncommon — your fire shows in how you decide, not how you burn.
Leo.water: A Leo that leads with Water is rare — the warmth turns inward first, and what the room sees is the second draft of it.

Virgo.fire: A Virgo that leads with Fire is uncommon — the standard comes with heat behind it, and you will burn a week to get one detail right.
Virgo.earth: A Virgo that leads with Earth runs true — you improve what is in front of you, and the improvement is specific enough to point at.
Virgo.air: A Virgo that leads with Air is a genuine cross — the precision goes into language, and you can take a muddled idea apart in one sentence.
Virgo.water: A Virgo that leads with Water is uncommon — you notice what is wrong with a person the way other people notice weather, and you say almost none of it.

Libra.fire: A Libra that leads with Fire is uncommon — the balance is a decision you keep making, and you make it fast and out loud.
Libra.earth: A Libra that leads with Earth is a genuine cross — you weigh things by what they cost to keep, and your taste is a working budget.
Libra.air: A Libra that leads with Air runs true — you hold both sides long enough to see the shape of the whole, and only then take one.
Libra.water: A Libra that leads with Water is rare — fairness for you is a felt thing, and you will carry an imbalance for months rather than name it.

Scorpio.fire: A Scorpio that leads with Fire is uncommon — the depth is loud rather than quiet, and people know exactly where they stand with you.
Scorpio.earth: A Scorpio that leads with Earth is a genuine cross — the intensity goes into what you build, and you are patient in a way that unsettles people.
Scorpio.air: A Scorpio that leads with Air is rare — you take a thing apart to understand it, and the understanding is where the intensity lands.
Scorpio.water: A Scorpio that leads with Water runs true — you go to the bottom of a thing on the first pass, and shallow company tires you within the hour.

Sagittarius.fire: A Sagittarius that leads with Fire runs true — the arrow leaves the bow, and the aiming happens on the way.
Sagittarius.earth: A Sagittarius that leads with Earth is a genuine cross — the horizon is still the point and you now carry provisions, which is why you actually arrive.
Sagittarius.air: A Sagittarius that leads with Air is uncommon — you travel through ideas as readily as places, and the argument is the journey.
Sagittarius.water: A Sagittarius that leads with Water is rare — the search is inward as often as outward, and you go furthest when nobody is watching.

Capricorn.fire: A Capricorn that leads with Fire is uncommon — the climb is driven rather than dutiful, and you are competing with a version of yourself.
Capricorn.earth: A Capricorn that leads with Earth runs true — you build in stone, on purpose, and you would rather be early than impressive.
Capricorn.air: A Capricorn that leads with Air is a genuine cross — the structure is in the thinking first, and you can see the whole ladder before you touch it.
Capricorn.water: A Capricorn that leads with Water is rare — the discipline is protecting something soft, and the people who get past it stay for good.

Aquarius.fire: An Aquarius that leads with Fire is uncommon — the distance you keep is a position, and you will defend it warmly and at length.
Aquarius.earth: An Aquarius that leads with Earth is a genuine cross — the odd idea comes with a plan attached, which is what makes people follow it.
Aquarius.air: An Aquarius that leads with Air runs true — you think from outside the room on purpose, and the view from there is the contribution.
Aquarius.water: An Aquarius that leads with Water is rare — the detachment is a way of caring at scale, and the individual case still gets to you.

Pisces.fire: A Pisces that leads with Fire is uncommon — the dreaming has an engine under it, and what you begin tends to get finished.
Pisces.earth: A Pisces that leads with Earth is a genuine cross — you make the imagined thing real, which is the rarest half of imagination.
Pisces.air: A Pisces that leads with Air is rare — the feeling arrives already translated, and you can explain a mood to the person having it.
Pisces.water: A Pisces that leads with Water runs true — you take on the room's weather without meaning to, and solitude is maintenance rather than sulking.

cusp.fire: Born on a cusp and leading with Fire — you carry two seasons' energies and one of them moves first, every time.
cusp.earth: Born on a cusp and leading with Earth — two energies sit in you, and the steadier one is the one people meet.
cusp.air: Born on a cusp and leading with Air — you hold two natures at once, which is why you can argue both sides and mean both.
cusp.water: Born on a cusp and leading with Water — the two energies you sit between meet in what you feel rather than in what you do.
